disposition: Two actionable P2 source/contract findings and one P3 coverage wording correction; source closure pending bounded corrections. No candidate native acceptance.

findings.title: Reject health writes for a nonpositive capability
findings.mechanism: A valid ordinary vehicle request with damage_level80, initial100, cheat_guard0 accepts DONE/exited0/capability0/written1/new_level0/critical_before0/critical_after1/bad_modifier0/no echo. The result passes class, invulnerability and level-range checks, then damage.c:472 sets health0 and the handler credits/kills the target. Negative capability behaves the same. This contradicts the documented contract that a capability of zero or less does nothing.
findings.bounded_correction: Reject written when capability<=0 before applying the answer. Preserve valid zero/negative unwritten answers and generic-host freedom over positive-capability health outcomes; do not recompute the host solver or require exact subtraction in core.
findings.meaningful_check: Extend the existing production mb_hostaim.c C guard with zero and negative capability paired with written1 and a decreased level; both must refuse. Keep zero/negative unwritten/no-transition cases accepted.
findings.evidence: Source-verified branch walkthrough; no new test/build/native executed.

findings.title: Preserve legitimate centred-hit diagnostics through the fixture round trip
findings.mechanism: The explicitly covered centred vehicle solid-shot case (weapon_position==target_position, non-easy armour) has norm0, producing NaN aspect armour. The original non-HE comparison is false and returns capability0 without converting NaN to int or writing health. The retained new kernel test checks only this outcome without echo. Fixture damage always requests echo; main copies outcome.armour NaN into echo.f, which the Lua exact-number/C all_finite echo validation rejects. Thus a supported no-op hit becomes fatal in the default fixture/public path, although shipping without echo returns0.
findings.bounded_correction: Make the optional diagnostic representation capable of carrying the original intermediate float bit patterns, including this NaN, losslessly without weakening finite validation for physical request/result fields. Do not sanitize the physics, fabricate a finite armour value, omit the observer call/counters or change a golden to pass.
findings.meaningful_check: Exercise the actual host Lua callback plus production exchange/fixture consumer for the centred solid-shot input with echo enabled; verify capability0/unwritten and faithful intermediate hash/accounting. Retain ordinary finite echo and malformed physical-value refusal checks.
findings.evidence: Source-verified original branch, kernel output and echo validation; not a shipping formula finding. No new test/build/native executed.

findings.title: Correct the anti-aircraft coverage limitation
findings.mechanism: The statement that a fatal anti-aircraft hit was not reached by any retained original run conflicts with the already accepted f41 natural600: ANTI_AIRCRAFT collisions5/fatal5. The unreached case is the fatal anti-aircraft timed fire roll, not every fatal hit.
findings.bounded_correction: Acknowledge the five observed fatal AA collisions; if intended, qualify the missing fatal path as the anti-aircraft timed-fire roll. Preserve the genuine player/MP/invulnerability/easy-armour limitations.
findings.evidence: Previously closed original natural600 record; no repeated original evidence review or native run.
